liquidity_funding.text: Cash and cash-like investments fell by {{cash_like.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_like@FY2024}}, and cash liquidity by the same measure to {{cash_liquidity@FY2024}}.
In FY2023 the group held liquidity of {{liquidity@FY2023}}, including {{undrawn_facilities@FY2023}} of undrawn committed facilities, and liquidity to revenue of {{liquidity_to_revenue@FY2023}}.

The cash decline reflects debt repayment, with total debt down {{total_debt.change@FY2024}} to {{total_debt@FY2024}}, and Fitch raised the long-term rating during the year with the outlook held stable.

operating_performance.text: Passengers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, though traffic growth slowed by {{traffic_growth.change@FY2024}} to {{traffic_growth@FY2024}}.

Aeronautical revenue per passenger rose by {{aero_revenue_per_passenger.change@FY2024}} to {{aero_revenue_per_passenger@FY2024}}, with the CNMC setting the 2025 maximum adjusted revenue per passenger at the prior year's level.

Operating profit rose by {{operating_profit.change@FY2024}} to {{operating_profit@FY2024}}, and profit for the year by {{profit.change@FY2024}} to {{profit@FY2024}}, the latter including the gain on the sale of the ESSP SAS stake.

watch_items.text: Liquidity: cash liquidity to revenue fell by {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue.change@FY2024}} to {{cash_liquidity_to_revenue@FY2024}}, so the buffer against maturities is thinner than a year earlier.

Coverage: interest coverage eased by {{interest_coverage.change@FY2024}} to {{interest_coverage@FY2024}}, a mild weakening even though it remains above the peer median of {{interest_coverage.peer_median@2024}}.

Traffic: passenger numbers rose by {{passengers.change@FY2024}} to {{passengers@FY2024}}, but the CNMC set the 2025 maximum adjusted revenue per passenger at the prior year's level, so traffic is the main driver of aeronautical revenue.
Portfolio: the Cartagena concession ended in the year, so the contribution from the Latin American operations is smaller.
